title: When the Signal Turns Again
author: Emrys Dravenmoor
blurb: Wren Fairweather, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
